title: Plates +
description: This mod adds more plates to Minecraft
body: This mod adds more plates to Minecraft. These will mostly be metal plates. The mod adds: Copper plate, Diamond Plate, 2 Netherite plates (from a block and from a shard), Cobblestone Plate, as well as Emerald Plate. In addition, the mod adds crafting for all of these plates.All plates work as weight plates (iron plates).
